theorems.name: Submission.allard52_lad_hasFDerivAt_of_line_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)) (x : Rn n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → ContinuousOn g U → (∀ y ∈ U, f y - f x = ∫ τ in (0:ℝ)..1, g (x + τ • (y - x)) (y - x)) → HasFDerivAt f (g x) x
